idea-plugin.name: Syrobin Java Code Generate
idea-plugin.description:
Syrobin Java Code Generate is a full-featured, intelligent Java backend code generator plugin for IntelliJ IDEA, designed to eliminate repetitive scaffolding work and accelerate microservice & enterprise application development.

Syrobin Java Code Generate 是一款面向 IntelliJ IDEA 的全功能、智能化 Java 后端代码生成插件，旨在消除重复的脚手架编码工作，全面提速微服务与企业级应用研发。

Key Features (English)

  • 11-Layer Full-Stack Generation: One-click or modular generation of Entity, BO, VO, Query, Enum, Mapper, Service, ServiceImpl, ServiceQuery, ServiceResults, and Controller.
  • Multi-Dialect & Offline DDL Engine: Supports live metadata extraction from MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, and Dameng (DM8), one-click datasource auto-discovery from Spring application.yml / properties, and 100% offline CREATE TABLE DDL SQL parsing.
  • Smart Incremental Merge & Diff Preview: Preserves hand-written business methods and custom imports when table schemas evolve, with side-by-side IntelliJ DiffManager preview before writing.
  • Smart Annotation & Enum Inference: Automatically generates Swagger 2 / SpringDoc OpenAPI 3 documentation annotations, Bean Validation constraints (@NotBlank, @NotNull, @Size, @Email, @Pattern, @PositiveOrZero) for both Spring Boot 2 (javax.*) and Spring Boot 3 (jakarta.*), and type-safe Enum classes from full/half-width column comments.
  • Built-in FreeMarker Template Center: Customize, preview, reset, or export all 11 FreeMarker (.ftl) templates directly inside Settings / Preferences -> Tools -> Syrobin Code Generate with zero external middleware dependencies.

核心特性（中文说明）

  • 11 层后端代码一键/按需生成：支持多表批量生成或单层独立生成 Entity、BO、VO、Query、Enum、Mapper、Service、ServiceImpl、ServiceQuery、ServiceResults 与 Controller。
  • 多数据库方言与离线 DDL 解析引擎：原生适配 MySQL、PostgreSQL、Oracle、达梦（DM8）四大数据库元数据提取，支持一键扫描工程 application.yml / properties 自动识别数据源，并提供离线 CREATE TABLE SQL 解析与 .sql 文件右键直接生成能力。
  • 智能增量代码合并与 Diff 预览：表结构新增字段时，仅增量追加新增成员变量与缺失 import，100% 保留开发者手写的业务方法与自定义逻辑，并支持调起 IDEA 原生 DiffManager 左右分栏对比确认。
  • 文档注解、校验注解与枚举智能推断：支持一键切换 Swagger 2 / SpringDoc OpenAPI 3 注解风格，适配 Spring Boot 2 (javax.*) / Spring Boot 3 (jakarta.*) 自动推断 @NotBlank、@NotNull、@Size、@Email、@Pattern、@PositiveOrZero 校验注解，并兼容中英文全/半角括号注释自动生成枚举类。
  • 内置 FreeMarker 模板配置中心：内置 11 套开箱即用的默认模板与本地工作区持久化能力（零 Redis 依赖），支持在 Settings / Preferences -> Tools -> Syrobin Code Generate 中在线编辑、恢复默认或导出模板至工程 /src/main/resources/templates/ 目录。
idea-plugin.change-notes:
v2.2.0 - UI Refinement & Generation Reliability (界面优化与生成可靠性修复)

  • Refined table selection, file previews, Query empty states, and source/verification status (优化选表、文件预览、Query 空态及来源验证状态)。
  • Isolated per-table Query fields and conditions during batch generation (修复批量生成时不同表的 Query 规则串用)。
  • Rejected tables absent from offline DDL without JDBC fallback (离线模式拒绝未知表，禁止回退数据库)。
  • Invalidated metadata previews and stale requests after connection changes (连接变更后使旧元数据预览和过期请求失效)。

v2.1.0 - Full Architecture & Intelligence Upgrade (全架构与智能化升级)

  • Brand & Visual Upgrade (品牌与视觉升级): Updated plugin ID (com.syrobin.java.code.generate), author metadata (syrobin), and custom vector icons for Light & Dark themes.
  • P0 Baseline Governance (基线治理): Non-blocking modeless wizard compatible with IntelliJ IDEA 2023.3 ~ 2026.1+ and JDK 21~25+, accurate bigint -> Long mapping, UTF-8 file writing, and automatic VFS project tree refresh.
  • P1 Unified Wizard & Zero External Dependencies (一体化向导与去外部依赖): 4-tab DialogWrapper wizard, workspace-scoped PersistentStateComponent storage, 11 built-in FreeMarker fallback templates, and full/half-width enum comment parser.
  • P2 IDE Ecosystem Integration (IDE 生态深度集成): Incremental Java field/import merger, native DiffManager side-by-side preview, Settings FreeMarker template center, multi-dialect support (MySQL / PostgreSQL / Oracle / DM8), and Spring application.yml datasource auto-scanner.
  • P3 Offline DDL & Smart Validation (离线 DDL 与智能校验): Offline CREATE TABLE SQL parser, right-click .sql file generator, and automatic Bean Validation annotation inference.
